arguments.sql: SELECT products.line, SUM(order_lines.quantity * products.unit_price) AS total_amount FROM orders JOIN order_lines ON orders.id = order_lines.order_id JOIN products ON order_lines.product_id = products.id WHERE orders.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY products.line
